title: MarsWalk Mission Snapshot
description: Deterministic, reproducible snapshot of all result-affecting input parameters, ordered coordinates, and dataset bounds.

input_fingerprint.description: Deterministic hex hash computed from canonical representation of all result-affecting inputs.

mission_id.description: Stable mission identifier associated with this snapshot.

canonical_mission.description: Normalized mission request containing start, goal, stops, profile, vehicle mode, and constraints.

ordered_points.description: Exact ordered sequence of (row, col) grid cells traversed: [Start, Stop_1, ..., Goal].

ordered_stop_ids.description: Ordered list of intermediate stop IDs.

model_version.description: Semantic version of the planning and simulation engine.

assumptions_version.description: Version identifier for the engineering assumptions ledger.
